items.title: SK Hynix Drops 5% After Approving $38B in New Memory Fabs; Seagate Falls 7%, Micron Barely Dips
items.summary: SK Hynix just committed to one of the biggest fab investments in memory history, and its stock immediately sold off. Whether that reaction signals panic over capital spending or a buying opportunity depends on a structural argument about 2027 that not everyone buys.

items.title: Tech Stocks Shake Off Another Memory Stock Slide
items.summary: Three of its top holdings, flash memory/data storage companies Seagate, Western Digital, and Sandisk, were among the biggest losers in the S&P 500 Friday.  The stocks continued to slide following Western Digital's earnings late Wednesday, which were merely good as opposed to mind-blowingly fantastic.  The memory ETF was being dragged down even more by Micron Technology and South Korean rival SK Hynix.

items.title: Seagate (STX) Stock Fair Value Rises After Analysts Lift Storage Demand Assumptions
items.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings is back in focus after analysts raised fair value estimates from US$959.48 to US$1,115.87, a sizeable reset in how models value the stock. Much of this shift relates to new research that takes a more positive view of pricing power in hard disk drives, AI-led storage demand, and the company’s margin and cash generation outlook.
